title: Exploring Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures for Self-Supervised Representation Learning of Powder X-ray Diffraction Patterns
abstract: arXiv:2610.33310v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) is the primary high-throughput method for resolving crystal structures, a cornerstone of materials science. As high-throughput synthesis and self-driving laboratories advance, automated XRD pattern analysis has become vital for accelerating materials discovery. However, traditional matrix factorization methods fail when lattice variations cause non-linear peak shifts. At the same time, supervised learning approaches face a combinatorial explosion when handling multi-phase mixtures. To overcome these challenges, we adopt a self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to learn representation embeddings from 1D diffraction patterns. By optimizing a masked self-prediction loss directly within the latent space, the framework captures high-level crystallographic semantics. Downstream evaluations show that lightweight attentive probes trained on frozen JEPA representations achieve space group c

translated_title: 探索联合嵌入预测架构用于粉末X射线衍射图谱的自监督表征学习
translated_abstract: 粉末X射线衍射（XRD）是解析晶体结构的主要高通量方法，而晶体结构是材料科学的基石。随着高通量合成和自驱动实验室的发展，自动化XRD图谱分析对于加速材料发现变得至关重要。然而，当晶格变化引起非线性峰移时，传统的矩阵分解方法会失效；同时，监督学习方法在处理多相混合物时面临组合爆炸问题。为了克服这些挑战，我们采用自监督联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）从一维衍射图谱中学习表征嵌入。通过直接在潜空间中优化掩码自预测损失，该框架能够捕获高层次的晶体学语义。下游评估表明，在冻结的JEPA表征上训练的轻量级注意力探针在空间群分类任务上取得了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出采用自监督联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）从粉末X射线衍射图谱中学习表征嵌入，通过潜空间掩码自预测克服了传统方法在非线性峰移和多相混合物分析中的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper adopts a self-supervised Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) to learn representations from powder XRD patterns, overcoming limitations of traditional methods with nonlinear peak shifts and multi-phase mixtures through masked self-prediction in latent space.
